summary: Zhihu Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing an HKEX announcement of a routine equity incentive grant: on October 16, 2026 the company awarded 809,802 RSUs to five employees under its Amended and Restated 2022 Share Incentive Plan, equal to roughly 0.32% of total shares outstanding on a one-share-one-vote basis. Purchase price is US$0.01 per RSU; reference market prices were HK$9.0 per Class A share and US$3.5 per ADS. Awards vest over 48 months with performance conditions and cause-based forfeiture/clawback; no company financing assistance. No board recommendation or advisor involved. This is an ordinary compensation event, not a special situation.
